column1: # soundness/known_open.tsv — the KNOWN-OPEN register for the two property gates.
# Each line is a shape at which candor-scan reports two spellings of ONE program
# differently, or (BOTH-PURE, SOUNDNESS R273) reports NEITHER spelling although the executed
# run dropped — i.e. A SILENT UNDER-REPORT THAT IS STILL OPEN. The gates subtract these so a
# NEW instance fails, and print them every run so they are not forgotten. This is a debt
# register, not a list of acceptable behaviours.
